name: Toxicologist’s Gift
body:
School transmutation; Level alchemist 3/legendary alchemist 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components v, S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 24 hours

DESCRIPTION

This extract is mixed with the rare poison of the crimson scorpion prepared in an incredibly exacting fashion, transforming an alchemist’s toxins into an invigorating mixture.

As long as you are under the effects of toxicologist gift, once per round when a creature fails a saving throw against one of your toxins, you gain a number of temporary hit points equal to your two times Intelligence modifier which last for the duration of this spell. For the spell’s duration, you gain a +2 alchemical bonus on all saving throws.
